A lot of work on my #Printrbot  lately... I calibrated the X and Y axis with this neat print (http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:1126) that uses a US nickel for comparison. A nickel has a diameter of 21.21mm and my first print measured about 20.2mm on each axis. After calibrating once, the nickel fit perfectly.
I recently installed #Ubuntu  on my 10-year-old HP laptop. It can get pretty sluggish even just loading webpages but it's good enough to permanently leave attached to the printer. I installed Printrun (http://reprap.org/wiki/Printrun) on it so I can print straight from the computer or SSH into it and use the command line interface to print from my main laptop (where I do all of my designing and slicing) or iPad if I really have the urge to print while in bed (hah). I'll try this setup out for a while and see how I like it. I want to try Octoprint (http://octoprint.org/) but I don't really want to switch my g-code sending program out because I'm so used to Pronterface. Maybe that's a job for a weekend.
